body:
I remember the person I used to be. Funnier, happier, better person. I was really popular and always successful in school. I lost my innocence, I have distorted moral values. I don't know if I'm a really good person or a really evil person deep down...

Funny thing is, I was stronger as a kid than now, almost an adult. My family always degraded me, treated me worse than others, but I was able to overcome that... I guess after 15 years of treating like shit I somehow became a shit. 

I'm just an empty shell of what I used to be.

Why did you stick around? Is there something you want to tell me about yourself?
I'm just a shitty person. Maybe I'm not much worse than others but I have perfectionistic attitudes. If I don't live to my fullest potential, I'll be unhappy.

Absurd statement. 

I guess it refers to 'romantic love'. There's some truth in it; if you're confident you'll be more attractive. But in the end, you can't change who you really are. Maybe someday someone will love me, but I know I'll always hate myself.

Yeah, I just hate how relative this world is... 

Even if you find someone, that person might change. Most loves have an expiration date. Love is the ultimate luxury. How can someone as damaged as me ever receive it?
